connector.name: Formacv
connector.registryDescription: FormaCV MCP server for AI-powered CV formatting, anonymization, tailoring, and ATS push-back.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rocketech-software-development account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FORMACV_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer credential issued by FormaCV after onboarding. Use 'demo' against demo URLs.

env.name: FORMACV_SERVER_URL
env.description: HTTPS origin of your isolated FormaCV deployment (e.g. https://demo.formacv.ai for demo mode).
